items.title: A 1970 Decision Still Shapes Your Database
items.summary: In episode 1017 of the SuperDataScience Podcast, @JonKrohnLearns talks with Pete Johnson, Field CTO at MongoDB, about the fundamental differences between NoSQL and traditional SQL databases. Pete provides a historical context, explaining how SQL prioritized disk storage efficiency in 1970, while modern NoSQL databases like MongoDB prioritize performance and developer time by using denormalized JSON structures, making them ideal for today's fast-paced AI applications.

items.title: How Much Math Do You Really Need for Machine Learning?
items.summary:
Do you need to be a math expert to learn machine learning?

In this short, Luis Serrano, author of Grokking Machine Learning, Second Edition, explains how much math beginners really need — and why understanding the intuition behind the math can matter more than memorizing formulas.

If math has been holding you back from learning ML, this is a great place to start.

Book: https://hubs.la/Q04rsqf30
